answer: A bond of 48% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in meadow, and terrace reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, anyone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 139 aliases, and each one needs its own funded wharf account. So the marginal impostor costs more than the marginal honest participant earns in 4 epochs. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
